statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space, and let $E_1,E_2,E_3,\dots \in \mathcal{F}$ satisfy $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(E_n)<\infty.$$ Then $$\mu\left(\bigcup_{n\geq N}E_n\right)\to0,$$ equivalently, almost every $x\in X$ belongs to at most finitely many of the sets $E_n$, that is, $$\mu(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)=0.$$
